Complete [[Sunjiang District]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Locate and destroy the source of the spirit army in the [[Sunjiang District (outpost)|Sunjiang District]] of [[Kaineng City]].
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in under 20 {{sic}} minutes.
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 5,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,000 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 30 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 45 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
As per the [[Sunjiang District#Walkthrough|Sunjiang District]] mission.
